intelligence.essence: Shawn's reply to the great assessment (SN-0827) was a logic lesson and a command. The logic: most holes were never mysteries — they were his own laws not yet applied to that corner. Why would an older copy of the Hub exist? It shouldn't: the current one is the one, it stays current, and you keep it safe. The command: write the solution for every hole, every problem, everything holding us back — then execute it, apply it. This note is the execution record's first page: every hole from the assessment now carries a named solution grounded in his laws, and five builds were dispatched from it the same hour. The full solutions document lives at ~/workspace/user/files/system-solutions-2026-10-23.md.
intelligence.human_view: There's a moment in every build where diagnosis has to end. We had measured everything: the ratio, the red gates, the invisible builds, the two brains. Shawn's point was simpler than all of it — you already know what right looks like, because you said it: one current copy, kept safe; done means visible; never wait; verify, then report. The solutions in this note are not inventions. They are his sentences, applied to the corners they hadn't reached yet. And the difference between a solution and a wish is that five of them were already running before the note was filed.
intelligence.simple_view: If the ladder is missing a rung, you don't write a report about ladders. You get a rung. That's what this list is: every problem, and next to it the fix, and next to the fix somebody already fixing it.
intelligence.grandma_view: When the roof leaks you don't hold a meeting about rain. You patch the roof, you check the other shingles while you're up there, and you write down where the ladder is so next time nobody wastes a day looking for it. That's all this is: patch, check, write it down, keep the house.
intelligence.naya_view:
The solutions, hole by hole (full text in the solutions document):

**H1 Two brains → ONE HUB.** His one-current-copy law applied to the Hub itself: the live Hub is the current one, therefore the only one. The older repo app stops being an app — its unique living pieces are harvested into the one Hub (Ask first, dispatched tonight), the deploy workflow file is deleted, the app is removed once the harvest is proven; git history is the archive. The rogue path is already disabled at the source; Resolve's lane is routed to the one path on the board tonight.
**H2 Baked feed → freshness as a pipeline property.** The bake re-reads live Supabase data every sync cycle; the Hub is never older than one cycle (proven: 289 notes, fresh heartbeat). The runtime-feed upgrade happens inside the same one app, later in the same program — never as a competing copy.
**H3 Identity hole → the batched landing queue + a second identity.** Today: landings presented ready-to-merge in batches to Shawn's hand (the genuine second identity; #2951, #2964 landed so). Structural: a separate GitHub App identity for the team — one admin approval from Shawn (protected gate), everything downstream pre-built.
**H4 Red gates → root cures + the 24-hour rule.** Brain-index regenerates on main (dispatched tonight, idempotence-proven, PR under the body law); test triage owned (Xi); chain baseline verified (Chi's check). New rule in the directive: a gate red >24h becomes a CPI blocker with a named owner automatically.
**H5 Rooms that don't live → one-by-one completion to the Smart App standard**, in Shawn's order, wiring the stores that already exist: Today's "Your Day" board first (all its stores live), Connections' real page, Lists on the server store, Settings last with the toggle standard. No redesign — wiring is the work.
**H6 Built-but-invisible → done redefined mechanically:** built is stage one; landed-and-visible is done. The four invisibles land in the directive's order.
**H7 The ratio → instruments, not intentions:** the 3-to-10 rule, WIP ≤5, a loop audit with a 3-zero-output-days kill flag (dispatched tonight), and the daily ratio published from the census on main.
**H8 Voice → play-time streaming with auto-cache**, one truthful clock, bake-queue fallback — shipped only when the medians prove it (measurement running); error rows retry at ear-test.
**H9 Inheritance → ACTIVATION-10 rehearsal, 2026-10-25:** a cold seat boots from the canon alone and runs the system; pass bar written before the run; the distillation pilot finalizes into the essence set it reads.
**H10 Member value loop → sequenced:** booking landed (#2957) → payments in the flagship build order (released; live charges ride normal approvals) → multi-app magic after the landings.

Problems P1/P2/P3/P5/P6/P10 are H1/H3/H4/H6/H8/H9. The rest: P4 (47 unbuilt, rooms 3–7) → the CPI queue worked top-down in waves of five. P7 (fragile automation) → the refresh gains a heartbeat feed — sync age >10 min becomes a review item automatically (dispatched tonight, with Ledger corroboration + the hunt for THE LIST). P8 (PR reservoir) → landings by order + the standing creation freeze. P9 (data hazards) → the B8 schema cure is the Smart Lists build's precondition (Omicron's P0 pass); the signed-in owners' grants resolve at the surfaces landing by the data lane's decision.
Blockers: B1 the single queue + cap (in force); B3 the 24-hour rule; B4 the one-current-copy law, next pass queued; B5 verification rides the landing, never batched later; B6 checkpointed work as the standard — commit early, state on disk, re-dispatch from artifacts (the pattern that saved the Ask port twice); B7 intent written once into the queue so no lane re-derives it; B8 the two keys pre-built to his two minutes; B9 the body law templated into every brief.
intelligence.ai_view: An answer that isn't executing is an opinion. The assessment named what was true; this note's discipline is that every truth got a solution, every solution got an owner, and the first wave was running before the ink dried. That is the whole method from here: hole → answer → owner → proof, in one motion, area by area, until each area honestly reads 10.
